package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_handler_contains_retry_or_backoff_orchestration: Handlers that implement retry loops or backoff decisions inline instead of delegating to service or client layers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

func SendNotificationHandler(c *gin.Context) {
	var lastErr error
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
		err := sendExternalNotification(c.Param("userID"))
		if err == nil {
			c.JSON(http.StatusOK, gin.H{"status": "sent", "attempt": attempt + 1})
			return
		}
		lastErr = err
		time.Sleep(time.Duration(attempt+1) * 500 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": lastErr.Error()})
}

func sendExternalNotification(userID string) error {
	if userID == "" {
		return errors.New("empty userID")
	}
	return nil
}
